column2: Wraps every texture TextureManager.getTexture loads in GeckoLib AnimatableTexture, a 1.20.1 SimpleTexture built on SimpleTexture.load(ResourceManager) and MetadataSectionSerializer; 26.3 replaced both (ReloadableTexture.loadContents, MetadataSectionType), so the wrapper throws NoClassDefFoundError on the first GUI texture. Without it textures load through 26.3; GeckoLib animated textures stay on their first frame
